question: ΔEFG and ΔHIJ are similar. Also, ∠E = ∠H and ∠F = ∠I. If 3EF = HI and FG = 9 cm, then IJ is equal to ____.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For similar ΔEFG and ΔHIJ, the ratio of corresponding sides is equal.

Given 3EF = HI ⇒ EF / HI = 1 / 3

Therefore, FG / IJ = EF / HI

9 / IJ = 1 / 3 ⇒ IJ = 27 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 27 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

ΔEFG ∼ ΔHIJ

∠E = ∠H and ∠F = ∠I

3EF = HI

FG = 9 cm

**Formula Used:**

When two triangles are similar, the ratio of their corresponding sides is equal.

**Calculation:**

⇒ ΔEFG ∼ ΔHIJ

⇒ EF / HI = FG / IJ = EG / HJ

⇒ We know that 3EF = HI, so EF / HI = 1 / 3

⇒ Substituting the given values:

⇒ 1 / 3 = 9 / IJ

⇒ IJ = 9 × 3

⇒ IJ = 27 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 27 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Similar Triangles

Corresponding angles are equal and corresponding sides are in the same constant ratio.

Area of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides: Area(Δ1) ÷ Area(Δ2) = (Side1 ÷ Side2)².

Perimeter of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides: P1 ÷ P2 = Side1 ÷ Side2.
